back: All costs **necessary** to acquire the asset and bring it to the **condition and location** for its intended use.
**Land** (not depreciated): price, closing costs, title, survey, clearing, demolition of old building (net of salvage). **Land improvements** (depreciated): paving, fences, lighting.
Allocate the total price by **relative fair values**.
WAAE × specific loan rate (up to loan amount) + excess WAAE × weighted-average rate on other debt. **Cap: actual interest incurred.**

front: Assets that do NOT qualify for interest capitalization
back: Routinely produced inventory, assets already in use/ready for use, land not being developed.
Record ARO liability at **fair value** (PV) and **add the same amount to the asset**; depreciate asset, accrete liability.
**Capitalize**: additions, improvements, life-extending repairs. **Expense**: ordinary repairs and maintenance.
